verdict.rationale: Expensify's own docs mention "Smart Limits on cards" and claim the company card lets admins "control spend" and "automate compliance." That implies amount-based limits on the Expensify Card, but there is no detail on how they work. Missing for 10: category-based restrictions, merchant-based restrictions, documented auto-lock or decline of out-of-policy spend at the point of sale, and any in-depth docs or independent corroboration of Smart Limits.
